title: Sales Manager - Affordable Housing Finance
description:
**Job Title:** Sales Manager – Affordable Housing Finance  
**Location:** Kadi/Varodara/Ankleswar/Rajkot Gujarat

**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** Minimum 2 years (Freshers: Full-time MBA graduates)

**Job Description**  
Looking for a Sales Manager – Affordable Housing Finance to sell affordable housing loan products and drive branch business growth. **This is a field-based**, individual contributor role reporting to the Branch Manager. It involves sourcing business through DSAs, connectors and other lead channels, supporting customers through the loan application process, and ensuring a great customer experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Sell Affordable Housing products for the organization
* Plan and execute the AH strategy for the month/quarter to ensure branch goals are overachieved
* Manage relationships with DSAs, connectors and individual sources from where business leads are generated
* Control and monitor the distribution network and plan sales promotion activities
* Handle documentation and support customers in building application files, resolving issues along the way
* Work with support functions for optimum TAT and service delivery
* Update customers on loan status and the resolution required
* Create a culture of customer satisfaction across all levels within the team
* Maintain database and prepare MIS and reports regularly
* Cross-sell insurance and related products

**Requirements**

* Graduate with minimum 2 years of relevant experience, or a full-time MBA graduate (fresher)
* Excellent communication skills
* Ability to understand business financials and assess the health of cases
* Strong relationship building and networking skills, with high integrity
* Good internal stakeholder management
* Good analytical skills and proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
* Willingness to travel regularly (field-based role)

**Job Details**

* Function: Business / Sales
* Grade: Executive
* Reports to: Branch Manager
* **Nature of role: Field-based (regular travel required), Individual contributor**

Pay: ₹459,000.00 - ₹469,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in Field based Role (Regular Travel Required)?
* Do you have experience in selling affordable housing products (Home Loan & Loan Against Property)?

Work Location: In person
